name: New Japan Chemical Co.,Ltd.
summary: New Japan Chemical Co., Ltd., formed in 1919 with headquarters in Osaka, Japan, makes and distributes chemical products internationally. Its range includes oleo-chemicals such as solidified oils, fatty acids and esters, glycerol, alcohols and surfactants, and plasticizers. It also offers custom hydrogenation services, including high-pressure processes and control of cis and trans isomer configuration.
